resources.string: Replace literal, case-sensitive text across this record’s saved transcript, including other pages. Up to 100 segments per batch. Empty replacement deletes text. Unsaved drafts and existing minutes stay unchanged.
The result is not confirmed. Retry the same request before making another change.
Changes saved. Review the transcript before generating new minutes.
The transcript changed. Nothing was overwritten. Preview again; undo cannot overwrite later corrections.
Cannot replace: check the text, empty results and the 100-segment / text-size limits.
Request failed or its result is unknown. Retry; do not start a duplicate replacement.
Recovery storage unavailable. No new changes can be submitted.
Restore every affected segment to its text before this batch? Any later correction to these segments prevents the entire undo.
